v.text: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
v.summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has scheduled investor meetings for 17th, 18th, and 19th November 2026. The company informed the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The announcement notes that the dates are subject to change due to exigencies. Sanjeev Grover, Executive Officer and Company Secretary, signed the communication on behalf of the company.
